nodes.label: CI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Sprint 0 of EXECUTIVE_TECHNICAL_BLUEPRINT.md §10 — no CI existed before. Lint is intentionally non-blocking (pre-existing backlog predates the ESLint config). test:routes is non-blocking because 3 of 81 tests fail against real pre-existing bugs (opsDashboardRouting 200-vs-404 routing-shadow regression; pulseNoMockData market-insights honesty-labeling; questionBankAdminRouting incorrectly 403-ing a non-admin user on an unrelated route, fails safe but is still a real bug) — fixing those is a separate tracked task, not bundled into this CI-coverage change.
